name: noon
verdict: Half owned by Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund.

why.text: Saudi Arabia’s state fund, PIF, owns half of noon. Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024.

note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): PIF owns 50% (a joint venture, not control).
